content: Etsy separates seller-deactivated listings (seller can reactivate freely from Shop Manager) from Etsy-deactivated listings (ONLY Etsy can reactivate; the seller's only route is a per-listing APPEAL within 180 days). Sellers report the deactivation notice often does not name the offending element, so the guidance becomes 'contact support for clarification' and appeal text becomes 'I checked all policies and believe this was a mistake'. This is the anti-pattern: with no fix-and-resubmit path, every rejection is forced into an adversarial appeal channel.
